name: nika_hat_with_cat_ears
description: Blue-haired character with long straight hair and brown eyes, with small colorful heart-shaped decals scattered on the cheeks. Wears a school uniform (white collared shirt, light blue sweater vest, pleated navy-blue skirt with white stripes, white knee socks, white sneakers), topped with a light gray cat-ear beanie covering the hair, with pointed ears on top.
